adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw` when `cook_method == :raw_html`, bypassing the normal cooking pipeline (`post_analyzer.cook`) and `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts from external RSS/Readability HTML with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true`, so arbitrary external HTML can be stored as `raw`/`cooked` without sanitization. The embed view then renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`, making stored XSS from imported content directly exploitable in the embedded iframe.
